data.body: 2026-09-28 task 153 (number 152, finished): Chat tool-call card reworked. New desktop/src/chat/toolCallPresentation.ts (static capabilityId->display-name map; shell dialect from the webview host identity; unwraps the {callId,...,arguments} envelope into labelled formatted arguments; extracts tool text from the canonical {callId, content, isError} result; text-free results become compact statuses) + ToolCallCard.tsx/toolCallCard.css, dispatched from ConversationTimeline for kind tool. Interpretation: the maximum input height is the card's 10-row expanded cap in code rows (--aw-tool-rows), so text scaling applies; an expanded field remeasures its virtual row via aworkit-activity-row-resize. No backend, projection, ordering, status or Run details change; design element aworkit.desktop_ui.conversation unedited. Evidence: pnpm check clean, pnpm build ok, pnpm test 564 pass (one earlier run had one unnamed flake). No linked QA job.
